environment.description: Same container image deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' level. The container spec sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the securityContext. No emptyDir, hostPath, or persistent volume claims are attached to the pod. The container's ephemeral storage is limited to 0Mi via resources.limits.ephemeral-storage. Node-level gVisor (runsc) sandbox is enabled via RuntimeClass 'gvisor' which intercepts all syscalls including open/openat with O_WRONLY/O_RDWR flags against the overlay filesystem. The service mesh (Istio sidecar) enforces mTLS but does not restrict file operations.

config.notes: No writable mount points exist. /tmp, /app/uploads, /app/extracted are all part of the read-only root filesystem overlay. Container will receive EROFS (errno 30) on any write syscall.
